correct_completion: is playing football in the park.
full_sentence: Right now, my brother is playing football in the park.
acceptable_variants: is kicking a ball in the park.
is running around in the park.

options.text: plays football in the park every day.
options.why_wrong: The simple present describes routines. 'Right now' signals an action in progress, which needs the present continuous.

options.text: is play football in the park.
options.why_wrong: The present continuous needs the -ing form of the main verb, so 'play' must become 'playing'.

options.text: is playing football in the park.
played football in the park yesterday.
options.why_wrong: The past simple refers to a finished action. 'Yesterday' and 'right now' cannot describe the same moment.

grammar_focus: Present continuous for actions happening now (am/is/are + verb-ing)
explanation: The phrase 'right now' points to an action in progress, so the present continuous is needed: a form of 'be' followed by the -ing form of the verb. Polish speakers often use one simple present tense for both routines and current actions, so this contrast needs focused practice.
translation: W tej chwili mój brat gra w piłkę w parku.
